text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It... reached them...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
At the summit of 3,600 meters...!
I, myself, stand victorious right nowww!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: To all my classmates across the country, were you watching!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is what it means to be Class Rep!
Behold my race—a model for all to follow!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you very much!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haaahhh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am! Over! Whelmed!
With emotion!!!
For a while, Sakura Bakushin O savored the deep emotion...
On the way back from the Centaur Stakes...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh my.
The wind has grown quite chilly, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's almost autumn, isn't it...?
I was able to spend a truly fulfilling summer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If I do say so myself,
I feel like I've become quite tough and dependable!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
After all, I ran the whole 3,600 meters!
*smug*
choice_data_list: Then let's put that power to the test.
Then let's put that power to the test.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh!
This is about the next race, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Let's try it right away!
Looking ahead from now, there's the Tenno Sho (Autumn), and—"
choice_data_list: It's the Sprinters Stakes, plain and simple!

text_block_list.text:
I want to see just how much strength
she can display on that stage now.
I'd love to test my mettle against her...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wait, again!?
That's the sprint of all sprints, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Why on earth do I have to go back to sprinting
after running a full 3,600 meters?!
choice_data_list: Still, Nishino Flower is running, you know.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, Flower-san is?!
The very one with whom I fought so many fierce battles...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...!
I did want to compete again, but still!
choice_data_list: They're the perfect opponent to test how much you've grown!
They're the perfect opponent to test how much you've grown!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: True...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
After running a full 3,600 meters, just how far ahead
of Flower-san will I be...? I simply must know!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
For really, truly, this is the last time, okay!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"—Let's run
the Sprinters Stakes!"
And so, the next target race was decided: a second shot at the Sprinters Stakes!
